content.short: Protofire provides blockchain development for DeFi, tokenization and institutional onchain finance.
content.description: Protofire is a blockchain development firm working on DeFi, tokenization, real-world assets and stablecoin infrastructure for institutional clients. It also runs infrastructure deployments for chains, including a Safe multisig deployment for Plasma that Plasma's documentation lists under account abstraction. It is the team behind Chainlove, which appears separately in the registry.
content.meta: Protofire provides blockchain development for DeFi and tokenization, and runs Safe for Plasma.
